name: Scarlet
title: Candle Square
description: A Dragon girl who dreams of becoming a Grand Couturier. Her lack of common sense regarding human society often leads to her causing trouble and getting scolded by Claire.
introduction:
A Dragon girl of the Bellarmini clan and descendant of the <color=#F7BE45>Grand Couturier</color>, she overseas field training and equipment repairs at Candle Square.
Scarlet does not hesitate to undertake actions that are difficult to understand by human standards, causing frequent disturbances of various scales within Candle Square.

However, this is because she is still unfamiliar with human society, and although she has lived far longer than humans, she is still growing as a Dragon, leaving her with childish thoughts and behavior. Consequently, she is comfortable playing with children and has become quite popular with them.

She came to NOA to <color=#2A80D8>ask Alicia, who was once a colleague of the Grand Couturier, about traces left by the Grand Couturier</color>. However, at Claire's suggestion to work while she waited for an answer, she ended up staying at Candle Square.
When the invitation to the Journey arrived, she decided to participate on the spot, believing that nothing was impossible for a noble Dragon like her... but in reality, she did not fully understand what she was signing up for.
